mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods with a sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or the Rank IC of the signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods with UNRATE rising > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 270 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.25%, the market perceives a delayed monetary response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods meeting the condition, or the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0), the market anticipates reduced corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods with a sustained HOUST rise, or the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 275 signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 275, or the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both employment growth (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed their 3-month moving averages, the market perceives robust consumer spending and corporate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods where both PAYEMS and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%), the market anticipates reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods where UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
